# S2.SMU.EDU

> Faculty research profiles and educational resources at Southern Methodist University, covering polymer chemistry, economics, embedded systems, and operations research.

S2.SMU.EDU hosts faculty profiles, course materials, and research toolkits for SMU's academic community. The site features prominent researchers in chemistry and economics, along with educational software and course documentation for engineering and operations research disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Southern Methodist University
- Faculty profiles
- Polymer chemistry
- Economics research
- Labor economics
- Macroeconomic policy
- Embedded systems
- Microcontrollers
- Operations research
- Optimization
- Nick Tsarevsky
- Rocio Madera
- Dallas
- Education policy
- Research interests

## Faculty Profiles

- [Nick Tsarevsky - Polymer Chemistry](https://s2.smu.edu/nvt/nick.html): Faculty profile for Nick Tsarevsky, polymer chemistry researcher at SMU with expertise in macromolecular synthesis and controlled polymerization
- [Rocio Madera - Economics Research](https://s2.smu.edu/romadera): Faculty profile for Rocio Madera, economics researcher at SMU specializing in labor economics and macroeconomic policy

## Educational Resources & Courses

- [ECE 3181: Microcontrollers and Embedded Systems Lab](https://s2.smu.edu/~camp/courses/ece3181_sp21/index.html): Course materials for ECE 3181 microcontrollers and embedded systems laboratory, including lectures and hands-on embedded systems projects
- [Operations Research Toolkit](http://s2.smu.edu/~barr/ortoolkit): Educational software toolkit for operations research and optimization, designed for students and researchers in quantitative analysis

## Optional

- [Evolution Controversy in Texas Schools](https://s2.smu.edu/jkobylka/New%20York%20Times%20Items%202003/evolution%20controversy%20in%20TxSchools.htm): Archived news article on evolution controversy in Texas schools and education policy debates
- [WNBA Standings](https://s2.smu.edu/~olinick/RIOT_Dev-master/WNBA_standings.html): WNBA basketball league standings and team rankings
